title: Dragonborn (Solstheim)
description: Face Miraak, the first Dragonborn, on the island of Solstheim and in Hermaeus Mora's Apocrypha, plus the island's side quests.

items.title: Dragonborn
items.location: Windhelm, the Northern Maiden, Raven Rock
items.description: Cultists who call themselves servants of the true Dragonborn attack you. In Windhelm, board the Northern Maiden and sail to Solstheim to find out who Miraak is.

items.title: The Temple of Miraak
items.description: Explore the Temple of Miraak with Frea of the Skaal, learn the first word of the Bend Will shout and face Miraak in Apocrypha for the first time.
tips: This is also where you get the Black Book: Waking Dreams. You'll need it for the finale.

items.title: The Fate of the Skaal
items.location: Skaal Village, Saering's Watch, Wind Stone
items.description: Escort Frea to Skaal Village and use the Bend Will shout to free the Wind Stone from Miraak's influence.

items.title: Cleansing the Stones
items.location: Beast, Sun, Earth and Water Stones
items.description: Optional: cleanse the other four All-Maker Stones and free the workers Miraak forced to build his temples.
tips: Each cleansed stone can be used once a day for its own blessing.

items.title: The Path of Knowledge
items.description: Ask the Telvanni wizard Neloth for help and go with him to the Black Book: Epistolary Acumen in the flooded Dwemer ruins of Nchardak.
tips: In Nchardak you drain and flood rooms one after another by switching the valves.

items.title: The Gardener of Men
items.description: In Apocrypha, Hermaeus Mora offers the last word of the shout in exchange for the secrets of the Skaal. Storn sacrifices himself reading the Black Book, and you get the full Bend Will shout.
tips: Storn's death is scripted and can't be prevented.

items.title: At the Summit of Apocrypha
items.description: Use Waking Dreams to get through the chapters of Apocrypha, tame a dragon with Bend Will and fight Miraak. Reward: Miraak's gear and the option to reset perks with dragon souls.
tips: Save your dragon souls for the finale: afterwards, one soul resets the perks of one skill tree and refunds the points spent.

items.title: Black Book: The Sallow Regent
items.description: Get through Apocrypha for this book and choose one of the powers: Seeker of Might, Seeker of Sorcery or Seeker of Shadows.
tips: You can swap any Black Book's power by reading it again and returning to the final chamber.

items.title: Black Book: The Winds of Change
items.description: The book is hidden deep in Raven Rock Mine. Powers to choose from: Companion's Insight, Lover's Insight, Scholar's Insight.
tips: Raven Rock Mine opens up during "The Final Descent".

items.title: Black Book: Untold Legends
items.description: The book is guarded by a Lurker in the riekling lair of Benkongerike. Powers to choose from: Secret Servant, Bardic Knowledge, Black Market.

items.title: Black Book: The Hidden Twilight
items.description: Neloth keeps this book in Tel Mithryn. Powers to choose from: Mora's Agony, Mora's Boon, Mora's Grasp.

items.title: Black Book: Filament and Filigree
items.description: The book lies deep in Kolbjorn Barrow and becomes reachable during "Unearthed". Powers to choose from: Secret of Strength, Secret of Arcana, Secret of Protection.

items.title: Experimental Subject
items.description: Neloth tests a spell on you. Get caught in the rain or step into water, then report the results.

items.title: Heart Stones
items.description: Mine a heart stone for Neloth from a deposit on Solstheim. It's the material that powers Ash Guardians.

items.title: Wind and Sand
items.description: Retrieve a copy of the book Wind and Sand for Neloth. Reward: gold and access to the Whirlwind Cloak spell tome.

items.title: March of the Dead
items.description: Fight off the ash spawn attacking the farm and find out who controls them. General Falx Carius awaits you at Fort Frostmoth.

items.title: The Final Descent
items.description: Descend into the Nordic ruins at the bottom of the mine, find the remains of Crescius's ancestor and take the Bloodskal Blade to defeat the dragon priest Zahkriisos.
tips: Power attacks with the Bloodskal Blade release a slashing wave of energy.

items.title: Served Cold
items.location: Raven Rock, Severin Manor, Ashfallow Citadel
items.description: Uncover the Severin family's plot against Councilor Morvayn and stop the assassination in Ashfallow Citadel. Reward: the right to buy a house in Raven Rock.
tips: Available after "March of the Dead" and "The Final Descent".

items.title: A New Debt
items.description: The moneylender Mogrul wants you to repay Drovas Relvi's debt, which you took over. Pay it (you can talk him into a lower sum or more time) or kill the moneylender.

choices.question: How to deal with the debt?

options.label: Pay Mogrul
options.result: The debt is settled and Mogrul stays alive.

options.label: Kill Mogrul
options.result: Nobody comes for the debt anymore, but it's a murder in town.

items.title: Paid in Full
items.description: Delvin's brother asks you to find Esmond Tyne's body and recover the Bonemold Formula. Requires the Thieves Guild quest "Meet the Family".

items.title: A New Source of Stalhrim
items.location: Skaal Village, Abandoned Lodge, Northshore Landing
items.description: Deal with the Thalmor at the lodge and find the smith Baldor Iron-Shaper. Afterwards you can forge stalhrim gear.
tips: Stalhrim is mined with the Bend Will shout: cleanse the deposit first, then use a pickaxe.

items.title: Retaking Thirsk
items.location: Bujold's Retreat, Thirsk Mead Hall, Hrothmund's Barrow
items.description: Help Bujold's exiled Nords retake Thirsk Mead Hall from the rieklings and find the legendary Hrothmund's Axe.

choices.question: Who do you help take Thirsk Mead Hall?

options.label: Bujold's Nords
options.result: You drive the rieklings out of the hall and Bujold becomes chief of Thirsk.

options.label: The rieklings ("The Chief of Thirsk Hall")
options.result: You help the rieklings hold the hall and kill the Nords.

items.title: The Chief of Thirsk Hall
items.description: The alternative to "Retaking Thirsk": help the rieklings by catching Bilgemuck and gathering scathecraw, then lead them against the Nords. At the end, the chief challenges you.
items.missable: If Bujold's Nords have already retaken the mead hall, this quest is unavailable.

items.title: Unearthed
items.description: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (in several payments) and help Ralis dig through to the tomb of the dragon priest Ahzidal.
tips: Inside: the Black Book: Filament and Filigree and Ahzidal's gear.

items.title: Deathbrand
items.description: Find the treasure map of the pirate king Haknir Death-Brand and collect his unique armor set across Solstheim. Requires level 36 and the Ancient Nordic Pickaxe.
tips: You get the Ancient Nordic Pickaxe from Glover Mallory in the quest "An Axe to Find".

items.title: Summoning Karstaag
items.description: Unmarked quest: find the skull of the frost giant Karstaag, place it on the throne in the castle ruins and defeat the spirit. Reward: the Summon Karstaag power, usable only three times per playthrough.
tips: One of the toughest fights in the game: come prepared.

items.title: The Ebony Warrior
items.location: A major Skyrim city, Last Vigil
items.description: At level 80, the Ebony Warrior, seeking a worthy death, meets you in one of the major cities. Defeat him at Last Vigil.
